name: Terenas Menethil II
summary: Across Lordaeron, Terenas Menethil II carries the weight of a kingdom through war and its aftermath. For more than five decades, he ruled as a wise and diplomatic king, forged the Alliance of Lordaeron during the Second War, and gave shelter to the young Prince Varian Wrynn. His murder by his corrupted son, Prince Arthas, began Lordaeron’s collapse to the Scourge.

sections.title: Architect of the Alliance
sections.body: When refugees from Stormwind reached the north with Sir Anduin Lothar, King Terenas Menethil II answered their call. He gathered the monarchs of the divided human kingdoms, along with envoys from Ironforge and Quel'Thalas, and brought them together in the Alliance of Lordaeron. Terenas did not claim command of its armies. He chose Lothar as supreme commander, uniting humanity’s kingdoms for the first time in millennia. Together, they defeated the Old Horde.

sections.title: The Strains of Victory
sections.body: After the Second War, Terenas insisted that surviving orcs be held in internment camps rather than executed. He believed peace might hold once their demonic fury faded. The camps placed a heavy tax burden on Lordaeron’s allies. Gilneas shut itself behind the Greymane Wall, Stromgarde left the Alliance over political disputes, and the high elves withdrew entirely. Terenas was left to bear the cost as the coalition fractured.

sections.title: The Fall of the Throne
sections.body: Terenas faced orc revolts led by Thrall, whispers of death cults in the north, and a mysterious plague. A wandering prophet urged the king to abandon Lordaeron and flee across the sea to Kalimdor, but Terenas dismissed him as mad. Soon after, Prince Arthas returned from his northern campaign, hailed as a victor. During the royal celebrations, Arthas knelt before his father, drew the runeblade Frostmourne, and drove it through Terenas’s heart. The kingdom was shattered.

faq.q: Who was King Terenas Menethil II?
faq.answer: King Terenas Menethil II ruled Lordaeron for more than fifty years and stood at the heart of northern politics. He founded the Alliance of Lordaeron to fight the Horde in the Second War and governed from Capital City until his murder.

Terenas died by his son Prince Arthas Menethil’s hand in the throne room. Corrupted by the runeblade Frostmourne during his expedition to Northrend, Arthas returned to Capital City hailed as a victor and drove the blade through his father’s heart.

faq.q: What was Terenas's relationship with Stormwind?
faq.answer: Terenas helped Stormwind survive. After the southern kingdom fell in the First War, he gave its survivors haven and raised Prince Varian Wrynn alongside his own son Arthas. He treated Varian like a second son until Stormwind could be reclaimed and rebuilt.

faq.q: Why did the Alliance of Lordaeron break apart under his rule?
faq.answer: Terenas chose to hold captured orcs in internment camps after the Second War rather than execute them. Their great cost stirred anger among the member realms. Gilneas built the Greymane Wall and isolated itself, Stromgarde left over policy disputes, and the elves of Quel'Thalas withdrew entirely.

faq.q: Did Terenas know about the Plague of Undeath?
faq.answer: Terenas knew of strange cults and a spreading sickness in the north, but underestimated the danger. Dalaran urged him to quarantine northern towns, yet he hesitated, fearing more suffering for his people. He sent Prince Arthas and Uther the Lightbringer to investigate, unaware of the trap awaiting them.

faq.q: Why didn't Terenas listen to the mysterious Prophet?
faq.answer: A cloaked prophet came to Terenas’s council chamber and urged him to evacuate Lordaeron’s people west to Kalimdor. Terenas dismissed him as an unhinged zealot, believing his armies, paladins, and sturdy kingdom could endure the coming trials.

angles.text: As a human, you remember King Terenas as a legendary patriarch who united the seven kingdoms against impossible odds. His sudden betrayal and death at his own son’s hands remain a national tragedy.
As an Alliance member, you inherit the legacy of the coalition Terenas forged with Anduin Lothar to defeat the Old Horde in the Second War.

As a paladin, you follow a path Terenas helped shape with Archbishop Alonsus Faol and Uther the Lightbringer when they fostered the Knights of the Silver Hand. Terenas guided his own son into the order.
As Forsaken, you once called Capital City home under Terenas, your last living sovereign. His fall doomed the realm to the Scourge.
